fix_and_optimize.prompt: Optimize - random pivot to avoid worst case:
fix_and_optimize.answer:
import random
def partition(arr, low, high):
    # Random pivot
    rand_idx = random.randint(low, high)
    arr[rand_idx], arr[high] = arr[high], arr[rand_idx]
    pivot = arr[high]
    i = low - 1
    for j in range(low, high):
        if arr[j] <= pivot:
            i += 1
            arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
    arr[i + 1], arr[high] = arr[high], arr[i + 1]
    return i + 1
fix_and_optimize.explanation: Random pivot prevents O(n²) worst case on sorted arrays.
